title: 第21章 金魄银针第22章 五毒教圣女
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
在聚宝阁的门口，摆放着两尊栩栩如生的金精狮子。
这两尊狮子身形矫健，肌肉隆起，神色威严，尤其是那双眼睛，更是炯炯有神，仿佛蕴含着无穷的威严。
它们静静地蹲守在门口，就像是两位忠诚的卫士，守护着这座商行。
江辰望着这两尊金精狮子，心中不禁暗暗惊叹。
金精是打造玄级兵刃的必备材料，没想到这聚宝阁竟然能够用如此珍贵的材料来打造门前的狮子，真是大手笔啊！
这时，他听到旁边有人在议论这两尊狮子的眼睛。
有人说，这两对眼睛是从一公一母两条杀人过千万的孽龙身上扣下来的。
这个说法让江辰感到有些匪夷所思，他不知道这是否是真的，但这样的传说无疑为这两尊狮子增添了几分神秘的色彩。
他仔细打量着这两尊狮子的眼睛，试图从中看出一些端倪。
然而，那两双眼睛却仿佛是两个深邃的漩涡，让人一看便不由自主地陷入其中，无法自拔。
江辰心中暗自庆幸，还好自己没有被这两双眼睛所迷惑，否则还不知道会陷入怎样的危险呢。
江辰收回目光，深吸一口气，然后迈步走进了聚宝阁。
进入其中，熙熙攘攘的人群让如此广阔的空间里都产生了一丝拥挤的感觉。
就在他到处乱逛的时候，一个店员迎了上来：“客官，您想买点什么？”
“你们店里有没有天品功法？”
江辰直接开门见山的问道。
“当然有，不过这种级别的功法价格太过于昂贵，而且数量极其稀少，恐怕只有三十层以上才能找到这种等级的宝物了。”
“那你们这三十层要怎么才能上去呢？”
江辰疑惑的问道。
“这个简单，要么您修为达到法相境，要么您在本店消费满一千万两黄金即可。”

“一千万两黄金？”
听到这个数字，江辰也不由得咋舌道：“恐怕这都能抵得上整个大明一月的税收了吧。”
在这个世界，大明要比过去的那个大明庞大的多。
广袤无垠的地域和庞大的人口基数，共同构筑了大明的繁荣与昌盛，为其带来了源源不断的税收来源。
得益于这片丰饶的土地与众多的人口，如今大明的年度税收已经攀升至了一个令人瞩目的高度。
十五亿两白银，这是一笔足以让任何国家都为之眼红的巨额财富。
然而，正如一枚硬币的两面，伴随着丰厚的税收，国家的开支也同样庞大得惊人。
从维护庞大的官僚体系到供养军队，从修建水利设施到赈济灾民，每一项都需要大量的资金投入。
因此，为了缓解财政压力，朝廷不得不赋予各级衙门一定的自治权，允许它们在一定的范围内自主筹措资金，以应对日益增长的开支需求。
以锦衣卫为例，他们在执行公务时缴获的战利品，并不需要全部上交朝廷，而是可以留下一部分作为自己的奖赏和经费。
此外，他们还可以借助手中的权力，从一些商户和百姓那里获取一些额外的“收益”
虽然这些行为在一定程度上损害了百姓的利益，但在朝廷看来，只要不过分，都是可以容忍的。
毕竟，相较于国家的整体利益而言，这些“小打小闹”
实在是微不足道。
当然，一千万两黄金的巨额财富，即便是换算成白银，也相当于一亿两之巨，在这个世界里，这样的数字无疑是相当恐怖的。
“那算了吧，我现在最多能去第几层？”
江辰直接开口问道。
聚宝阁中越往上，其中的宝物便越珍贵。
但是相对应的，能够上去的客户，要么就是修为通天，要么就是财富通神。
“我看您应该是先天境吧，不知客官是先天初期还是，先天境圆满呢？”
content_en:
At the entrance of Jubao Pavilion, there are two lifelike golden lions.
The two lions have strong bodies, bulging muscles, and majestic expressions, especially their eyes, which are piercing and sparkling, seeming to contain infinite majesty.
They squatted quietly at the door, like two loyal guards, guarding the business.
Jiang Chen looked at the two golden lions and couldn't help but marvel in his heart.
Gold essence is a necessary material for making Xuan-level weapons. I didn’t expect that the Jubao Pavilion could use such precious materials to build the lion in front of the door. What a generous act!
At this time, he heard someone next to him talking about the eyes of the two lions.
Some people say that these two pairs of eyes were plucked from the bodies of two evil dragons, a male and a female, who had killed over 10 million people.
This statement made Jiang Chen feel a little weird. He didn't know if it was true, but such a legend undoubtedly added a bit of mystery to the two lions.
He looked carefully at the eyes of the two lions, trying to discern some clues.
However, those two pairs of eyes seemed like two deep whirlpools, making people fall into them involuntarily and unable to extricate themselves at the first glance.
Jiang Chen was secretly glad that he was not fooled by these two pairs of eyes, otherwise he would not have known what kind of danger he would be in.
Jiang Chen withdrew his gaze, took a deep breath, and then stepped into the Treasure Collection Pavilion.
Entering it, the bustling crowd made such a vast space feel a bit crowded.
While he was wandering around, a clerk came up to him: "Sir, what do you want to buy?"
"Do you have Tianpin Kung Fu in your store?"
Jiang Chen asked straight to the point.
"Of course there is, but the price of this level of skills is too expensive, and the quantity is extremely rare. I am afraid that only treasures of this level can be found above the 30th floor."
"Then how can you get up to the 30th floor?"
Jiang Chen asked doubtfully.
"It's simple. Either your cultivation reaches the Dharma Realm, or you spend more than 10 million taels of gold in our store."
"Ten million taels of gold?"
Hearing this figure, Jiang Chen couldn't help but exclaimed: "I'm afraid this is worth the entire Ming Dynasty's tax revenue in January."
In this world, the Ming Dynasty is much larger than the Ming Dynasty in the past.
The vast territory and huge population base jointly built the prosperity of the Ming Dynasty and brought a steady stream of tax revenue.
Thanks to this fertile land and large population, Ming Dynasty's annual tax revenue has now climbed to an eye-catching height.
1.5 billion taels of silver, this is a huge amount of wealth that can make any country jealous.
However, just like two sides of the same coin, along with generous taxes, the state's expenditures are also staggeringly large.
From maintaining a huge bureaucracy to supporting the army, from building water conservancy facilities to relieving disaster victims, each of them requires a large amount of financial investment.
Therefore, in order to alleviate financial pressure, the imperial court had to grant various levels of government a certain degree of autonomy and allow them to raise funds independently within a certain range to cope with the growing expenditure needs.
Taking the Jin Yiwei as an example, they do not need to hand over all the trophies they capture while performing official duties to the court, but can keep part of them as their own rewards and expenses.
In addition, they can also use their power to obtain some additional "benefits" from some merchants and people.
Although these behaviors harmed the interests of the people to a certain extent, in the eyes of the court, they were tolerated as long as they were not excessive.
After all, compared to the overall interests of the country, these "small fights"
It's really insignificant.
Of course, a huge wealth of 10 million taels of gold, even if converted into silver, is equivalent to 100 million taels. In this world, such a number is undoubtedly quite terrifying.
"Forget it then,What is the maximum level I can go to now? "
Jiang Chen asked directly.
The higher you go up in the treasure gathering pavilion, the more precious the treasures are.
But correspondingly, the customers who can go up are either those who have great cultivation or wealth that leads to the gods.
"I think you should be in the Xiantian state. I wonder if you are in the early stage of Xiantian state or in the complete Xiantian state? "
